heading: Precedence of associate justices
lead: Associate justices shall have precedence according to the seniority of their commissions. Justices whose commissions bear the same date shall have precedence according to seniority in age.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 322 (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 216, 36 Stat. 1152). Minor changes in phraseology were made.
